name: AP_RECON_SUMMARY_DETAILS
description: This table stores the extract of the data, which is required for the preparation of the summary report.

columns.name: RECON_ITEM_ID
columns.description: This columns is the PK of this table. This is a running sequence number derived from the database sequence.

columns.name: RECON_ITEM_CODE
columns.description: This is the payables reconciliation report summary reconciliation item category.

columns.name: RECON_ITEM_ORDER
columns.description: Indicates the order in which the report categories will be sorted.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description:
The code combination id column will be populated for the values, which come from SLA or GL. The lookup codes for which CCIDs will be populated is:
OTHER
Gl_BEGIN_BALANCE
INVOICES
PAYMENTS
PREPAY_APP_UNAPP
NOT_POSTED_GL
NOT_TRFD_TO_GL
NON_AP_ACTIVITY
GL_VARIANCE
Gl_END_BALANCE
NON_AP_BEGIN_BAL
The data source in this case would be either SLA or GL or GL Plus.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: The ledger for which the data extraction is being carried out

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Set of records from which report information is retrieved.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: BU_ID
columns.description:
The bu_id will be populated for the amounts, which have the data source as  'AP'. The amounts which have the source as AP will be stored at BU level. For example, the Begin Balance will be stored for each BU. The lookup codes for which bu_id will be populated are:	AP_BEGIN_BALANCE
NON_AP_BEGIN_BAL
INVOICES
PAYMENTS
PREPAY_APP_UNAPP
AP_VARIANCE
AP_END_BALANCE

columns.name: AP_ACCTD_AMOUNT
columns.description: Transaction amount converted to the ledger currency and stored in subledger tables

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_DR
columns.description: The debit amounts will be populated for the amounts that are being extracted for SLA or GL.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_CR
columns.description: The credit amounts will be populated for the amounts that are being extracted for SLA or GL

columns.name: BALANCING_SEGMENT
columns.description: Value of balancing segment used to automatically balance journal entries.

columns.name: NATURAL_ACCOUNT_SEGMENT
columns.description: Natural account segment of the account code combination.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.
